welcome.tagline: Find trusted local help, or find work near you.

handymanJobFeed.emptyFiltered: No jobs match your filters. Try clearing some.

postJob.addressHint: Only shared with the handyman you hire — everyone else only sees the pueblo.

postJob.nudgeDescription: A description helps handymen understand the job. Post without one?
postJob.nudgeBoth: Jobs with a description and photos usually get better bids. Post without them?

browseHandymen.title: Browse Handymen
browseHandymen.description: Search and filter handymen by pueblo and trade, then view a profile or invite them to quote a job. Coming soon.

clientProfile.title: Your Profile

handymanProfile.title: Your Profile
handymanProfile.description: Logged in as {{email}}. Bio, certifications, and portfolio editing come later.

bidForm.title: Submit a Bid
bidForm.notePlaceholder: Anything the client should know about your quote...

myBid.title: Your Bid
myBid.hiredMessage: You got this job! The exact address is visible above.
myBid.rejectedMessage: The client chose another handyman for this job.
myBid.closedNoBid: This job is no longer accepting bids.
myBid.confirmWithdrawMessage: The client will no longer see your offer, and you won't be able to bid on this job again.

bids.title: Bids
bids.confirmMessage: This will hire {{name}} for ${{price}} and share your job's exact address with them. Other bids will be automatically declined.
bids.acceptError: Couldn't accept this bid. It may have already been withdrawn, or the job may no longer be open.

handymanPueblos.intro: Tap every pueblo you work in. You'll be notified about jobs posted there.

handymanTrades.intro: Pick every trade you do. You'll only see jobs that match one of these.

jobDelete.confirmDeleteMessage: This job has no accepted bid yet, so it can be deleted permanently. This can't be undone.
jobDelete.confirmCancelMessage: You've already hired a handyman for this job. Cancelling won't delete it, but it will end the job as cancelled for both of you.
jobDelete.error: Couldn't do that — the job may no longer be in a state that allows it.
